categories.main_business_segments: DoubleVerify operates as a single business segment focused on providing software for digital media measurement and analytics. Its solutions serve both advertiser customers (Measurement and Activation/programmatic) and supply-side customers (publishers and platforms), but all are delivered through a unified software platform.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include proprietary algorithms for ad fraud detection, brand safety and suitability, viewability, and geographic verification, all delivered via its DV Authentic Ad metric. Its platform leverages machine learning, semantic science, and AI for content classification, and is deeply integrated with major programmatic, social, and CTV platforms. The company uses a scalable, privacy-friendly, cloud-based infrastructure and agile software development methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: DoubleVerify’s primary customers are global advertisers, including over 50 of the top 100 global brands, as well as digital ad platforms and publishers. Key end markets include consumer packaged goods, financial services, telecommunications, technology, automotive, and healthcare, with a diversified customer base of over 1,000 clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: DoubleVerify serves customers in nearly 100 countries and maintains offices or commercial operations in 21 locations across 17 countries, including the United States, United Kingdom, Israel, Singapore, Australia, Brazil, Germany, and the United Arab Emirates. Approximately 40% of its employees are based outside the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: DoubleVerify operates as an independent, third-party measurement and analytics provider, sitting between buyers (advertisers) and sellers (publishers/platforms) in the digital advertising supply chain. It is not a media seller or buyer, but rather provides verification, analytics, and optimization services to both sides.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on expanding its measurement and analytics solutions across emerging digital channels (such as CTV and mobile), growing internationally, and deepening relationships with existing customers through innovation. R&D priorities include privacy-friendly analytics, contextual targeting, fraud detection, and expanding platform integrations. DoubleVerify also pursues opportunistic M&A to enhance its technology and market reach.
categories.revenue_model: DoubleVerify primarily generates revenue from measured transaction fees charged to advertisers based on the volume of digital ad impressions it verifies. Supply-side customers pay via monthly or annual contracts with minimum guarantees and tiered pricing. The business benefits from high customer retention and recurring revenue, with additional upsell opportunities as new solutions are introduced.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Integral Ad Science, Oracle’s Moat and Grapeshot, HUMAN (White Ops), and Zefr, as well as some platform-owned solutions. DoubleVerify differentiates itself through its independent, unified, MRC-accredited measurement across all major channels and platforms, broadest integration coverage, and strong global brand relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, DoubleVerify generated $452.4 million in revenue (up 36% from $332.7 million in 2021) and $43.3 million in net income. Adjusted EBITDA was $141.6 million (31% margin). The company has delivered a 35% compound annual revenue growth rate from 2019 to 2022, with high gross revenue retention (>95%) and net revenue retention rates (127% in 2022).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: DoubleVerify offers advertisers and publishers unbiased, privacy-friendly, real-time analytics that optimize digital ad spend, protect brand reputation, and ensure ads are seen by real people in suitable environments. Its unique DV Authentic Ad metric, broad platform integrations, and industry-leading accreditations provide a compelling ROI and trust, setting it apart as a best-in-class, independent measurement provider.
